description: Shield and formation - a tank that turns every block into threat, armour and retaliation.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 33 real CoA Vanguard talents (role Tank). Guardian measured the worst of the 16 classes remaining at 84% scalar-only nodes. ON_BLOCK is a live trigger and all four of CoA's blocking talents port. Dead keys this tree wanted and did not get: expertise, max_energy_bonus, block_chance, parry_chance, dodge_chance - the live names are block, parry, dodge. No critical-block mechanic exists (Iron Barrier re-pointed) and no immunity key (Hold the Line dropped; Frontier has no such ability either).

nodes.name: Iron Guardian
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA over 3 ranks: 'Increases your Stamina by 5%.' Authored at the full-investment ceiling with CoA's own 3 ranks, so the rank policy leaves it alone. stamina_pct takes percentage POINTS. The worksheet tagged this 'needs: pet-summon', which is wrong - there is no Iron Guardian pet in CoA's text, and the Guardian summons nothing (see tools/qa_pet_keys.py).

nodes.name: Heavy Expert
nodes.description: Increases your chance to parry and dodge by 4% and your armour by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your chance to parry and dodge by 4% and increase your Armor contribution from mail and plate items by 20%.' No key reads armour by item class, so the 20% applies to all armour - the Guardian wears plate anyway. THE LIVE KEYS ARE `parry` AND `dodge`, both PERCENT; parry_chance and dodge_chance read plausibly and are read by nothing. Dodge passes through _diminish() (character.py:1332), so 4% dodge is worth slightly less than 4% parry.

nodes.name: Knight's Conviction
nodes.description: Increases your block value by 50% and your chance to block by 2%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the block value provided by Raise Shield by 25% and your block chance by 1%.' Doubled for the two ranks. 'Provided by Raise Shield' cannot be scoped - block value is a character stat, not an ability's - so it applies always. TWO UNITS IN ONE EFFECTS BLOCK: block_value_pct is a raw FRACTION (0.50 is +50%) and `block` is a PERCENT added to the base chance and rolled against 0-100 (2.0 is +2 points).

nodes.name: Stalwart
nodes.description: Increases your block value by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your block value by 10% and your expertise by 4.' Doubled for the two ranks. THE EXPERTISE HALF IS DROPPED: `expertise` is read by no engine code, confirmed earlier this session when it turned up dead in another CoA tree. Authoring it would have been a line of text with nothing behind it.

nodes.name: Seasoned Fighter
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Pulverize, Ram and Broad Sweep by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. All three abilities exist in Frontier and the Guardian's resource is Energy (abilities.py:153), so the costs are real. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.description: Increases your block value by 25% and your chance to hit by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive: 'Increases your block value by 25% and your hit rating by 5% of your Stamina.' The block half ports exactly. The hit conversion does NOT - hit_rating is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, the same wall that took the spell-hit half of the Witch Doctor's Voodoo Power - so it is paid as a flat 5% hit instead, which works as a direct stat even though it cannot be a conversion target.

nodes.name: Footman's Call
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Pulverize by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Pulverize is increased by 15, plus an additional amount scaling with your block value.' No key makes an ability's damage scale off a defensive stat - the coefficients live on the ability - so the whole thing is expressed as damage, which is what a block-value rider would have delivered on a tank already stacking block value from three nodes in tier 0.

nodes.name: With Honor
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ram by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of Ram by -4 sec.' Expressed as a percentage because a flat second count is below a turn. POSITIVE reduces, so CoA's minus sign is dropped - authoring -0.25 would have LENGTHENED the cooldown.

nodes.name: Honorbound
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Shield Challenge by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Removes the Energy cost of Shield Challenge.' A full cost removal is expressible (1.0) but makes the ability free forever from a tier-1 node, so it is priced at half. CoA pairs this with Shieldbound ('no longer has a cooldown, but costs 10 additional Energy'), which is NOT built: nothing removes an ability's cooldown outright, and no key adds to a cost - _cost_pct is positive-reduces, so the trade-off cannot be expressed in either direction.

nodes.name: Retaliation
nodes.description: Blocking an attack strikes the attacker back for physical damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Successful blocks now deal 51 + 5% AP Physical damage to the attacker, scaling with defense rating. Can only occur once per sec.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - on_block is a live trigger and damage_flat with a school is a live payload. CoA's 51 becomes 55 flat; the AP and defense-rating riders cannot be read into a payload, which is why it is flat. 'Once per sec' needs no internal cooldown when a turn is three seconds.

nodes.name: Iron Barrier
nodes.description: Blocking an attack hardens your guard, raising your block value by 15% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Your successful blocks now have a 50% chance to critically block for twice the normal amount.' THERE IS NO CRITICAL BLOCK MECHANIC - blocking resolves as a flat value against the hit, with no crit roll anywhere in that path - so a doubled block cannot happen. Rebuilt as a block that makes the next blocks bigger, which is the same outcome spread over turns instead of landing at random. block_value_pct IS READ RAW ON BOTH SIDES - a fraction as a talent effect AND inside a status effect, unlike max_health_pct and healing_taken_pct, which flip between the two. My first draft authored 15.0 here on the assumption it flipped, which audit_talents reported as 1500%; 15% is 0.15.

nodes.name: Vanguard's Shield
nodes.description: Blocking or striking builds your guard, reducing magic damage taken by 2% per stack for 10 turns, stacking 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Blocking an attack or landing an auto attack now grants a stack of Vanguard for 1 min, stacking 10 times. Magic Damage taken reduced by 2%. Whenever you are hit by a spell, you lose 1 stack of this effect.' CoA's 2% and 10 stacks kept, and 1 min is 10 turns. THE SPEND-ON-SPELL-HIT HALF IS DROPPED: no payload removes a stack of an effect, so the ramp has no drain and this is stronger than CoA's. The auto-attack half is dropped too, so the stacks come from blocking alone rather than from two triggers - a second proc would double-stack on a turn where both happen. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT magic_damage_taken_pct is divided by 100 and POSITIVE INCREASES damage taken, so a reduction is NEGATIVE here; as a talent effect it is a raw fraction where negative also reduces.

nodes.name: Resilient
nodes.description: Blocking an attack steadies you, raising your maximum health by 8% for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Blocking an attack while Raise Shield is active now increases your maximum health by 308 + 10% Stamina + 11% AP for 15 seconds.' The 'while Raise Shield is active' gate does not exist - nothing reads whether a buff is up - so it fires on any block, with a 1-turn internal cooldown so a multi-hit turn does not refresh it repeatedly. The flat-plus-scaling number becomes a percentage, which is what it amounts to on a stamina-stacking tank. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT max_health_pct takes percentage POINTS, so 8% is 8.0 - 0.08 would have been 0.08%, which is the mistake that shipped briefly on Witch Hunter's Black Knight.

nodes.name: Battle Wary
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Advance and Battle Rush by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. Both abilities exist in Frontier. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Vanguard's Might
nodes.description: Heavy Blow steels you, reducing all damage you take by 5% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Heavy Blow now causes you to emanate an aura for 5 sec that reduces all damage taken by 5% for party members.' There is no party-aura mechanism, so the 5% lands on the Guardian and the description says 'you'. BARE damage_taken_pct IS READ RAW, so 5% is -0.05 - authoring -5.0 would be a 500% damage reduction, which is the immortality bug that shipped briefly on Boltslinger's Evasive at -20.0.

nodes.name: Bring Down The Hammer!
nodes.description: Heavy Blow leaves the enemy reeling, dealing physical damage over 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Heavy Blow now deals an additional 20% of the damage dealt every 1 sec for 3 seconds.' A repeated strike over 3 sec IS a dot, so this ports closely. The potency is flat rather than a share of the hit, because an apply_effect payload cannot read the triggering ability's damage.

nodes.name: King's Guard
nodes.description: Pulverize and Ram have a 10% chance to ready Raise Shield again.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Pulverize and Ram now have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of Raise Shield.' PORTS EXACTLY - CoA's 10%, and reset_cooldown as a BARE LIST is a full reset, which is what 'reset the cooldown' means. Note the chance is authored at 10 and the rank policy will spread it: at 3 ranks it becomes 3, reaching 9% at full investment rather than 10, which the description rounds to 10% as the ceiling.

nodes.name: Valorous Strikes
nodes.description: Your weapon swings have a 10% chance to strike twice and leave the target 3% less likely to hit you for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Auto attacks now have a 10% chance to strike an additional time and reduce your target's chance to hit by -3% for 15 seconds.' PORTS EXACTLY - on_weapon_swing is the live auto-attack trigger, extra_attack is a live boolean payload, and 15 sec is 5 turns. CoA's 10% and 3% both kept. A tank reducing the boss's hit chance is real mitigation here because hit_rating is rolled on the attacker's side.

nodes.name: Shield Unit
nodes.description: Taking damage stokes your fury, raising your attack power by 3% per stack for 10 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Each time you take damage, you gain 5% of the damage taken as attack power for 1 min.' NOTHING CONVERTS AN EVENT'S AMOUNT INTO A STAT - a payload cannot read the hit's size into a stat_mod - so an uncapped percentage of damage taken is not expressible, and it would be unbounded on a tank regardless. Rebuilt as a stacking percentage with a ceiling: 5 stacks of 3% is 15% attack power at cap, and 1 min is 10 turns. attack_power_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Order In The Court
nodes.description: Hammer of the Law cows the enemy, reducing the damage they deal by 10% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Hammer of the Law now reduces the damage dealt by affected enemies by -10% for 8 seconds.' Ports exactly - CoA's 10%, and 8 sec is 3 turns. Hammer of the Law exists in Frontier; CoA's silence rider on the ability itself is not a talent and has no key anyway. damage_dealt_pct inside a status effect is percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: The Green Tower
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Formations by 25% and raises the threat they generate by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the Energy cost of your Formations and increases their effectiveness by 25%.' Both Formations exist in Frontier. 'Effectiveness' has no single key for a Formation - they are stances, not damage - so the 25% is paid as threat, which is what a tank's Formation is for and what the spec's own level 10 passive already keys on. threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE increases, the opposite polarity to the _cost_pct keys beside it in the same block.

nodes.name: Valiant Defender
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Pulverize and Broad Sweep by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your maximum Energy by 15 and increases the damage of Pulverize and Broad Sweep by 10%.' THE MAXIMUM ENERGY HALF IS DROPPED: max_energy_bonus is read by nothing, and the primary resource pool is not talent-settable - the same shape as max_rage being hardcoded at 100. The damage half ports exactly.

nodes.name: Plate Buster
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Ram bring Bastion a turn closer to ready.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Ram now reduces the remaining cooldown of Hold the Line by 4 sec.' FRONTIER HAS NO HOLD THE LINE ABILITY, and CoA's version is an immunity to incapacitate, disorient, knockback and grip - none of which have a key here - so the target cannot exist either. Re-pointed at Bastion, the spec's real long-cooldown defensive, which is what Hold the Line occupies in CoA's kit. 4 sec is a turn.

nodes.name: Wreck Formation
nodes.description: Melee critical strikes have a 50% chance to ready Hammer of the Law again.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Melee critical strikes now have a 50% chance to reset the cooldown of Hammer of the Law. Casting Standard of Valiance now increases your attack power by 10% for 6 sec.' The first half ports exactly - CoA's 50%, bare-list reset_cooldown for a full reset. The second half would need a second proc on a different trigger; it is dropped rather than merged, because on_crit would not have fired on Standard of Valiance, a self buff that deals no damage. THERE IS NO TRIGGER-SIDE MELEE FILTER - proc school only types a damage_flat payload - so this fires on any crit, which on a shield tank is almost always melee.

nodes.name: Forceful Impact
nodes.description: Raise Shield and Heavy Blow extend Brace by 1 turn.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Raise Shield and Heavy Blow now extends the duration of your Brace by 1 sec. Brace cannot be extended beyond its maximum duration.' No payload extends a live effect's duration - consumes_stacks_of is the only thing that does and it reads the caster's own stacks to lengthen a DoT - so this is built as a flat duration bonus on Brace itself, which is the same outcome without the trigger. The small integer keeps this node out of the rank policy's reach.

nodes.name: Shieldlord's Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 15% and the damage of Heavy Blow and Hammer of the Law by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'You may now use two-handed Maces and can now equip two-handed Maces with a shield. Your Heavy Blow and Hammer of the Law now deal additional damage scaling with your Stamina and your Stamina is increased by 15%.' The weapon-rule half is not a talent effect - equip rules live on items, and a two-hander with a shield would need the slot system changed, which is well outside a talent. Stamina-scaling damage has no key (coefficients live on the ability), so it is paid as flat damage. CoA's 15% Stamina ports exactly, and stacks with Iron Guardian at tier 0 for 30% on a pure-Vanguard build. CoA's own Paragon node at this tier is the unresolved token '$32' and is not built.
